pairs.question: Sic definisti, ut nec deos consideris nec praecepta maiorum nec nostras minas timeas, ut contra rem publicam litteras accipias et dirigas?
pairs.answer: Ego de corona domini litteras accepi, non contra rem publicam.
pairs.derivation: Decius interrogates Cornelius. Framing tag 'dicensque ei :' dropped before the question; question quoted verbatim and contiguous to its terminal '?', first word capitalized. Answer framing 'Cornelius respondit :' dropped; answer is the full operative reply sentence, ending before 'Tunc Decius iussit os eius cum plumbatis cedi...' which is narration of the consequence, not part of the utterance.
